qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind reviews on the shared initial commit and serialized fix rechecks found the original correctness, comprehensibility and quiz-safety defects resolved. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, a preserved 幸い–幸福 disagreement and process deviations are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: EN exclusions are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received direct, one-sided exclusions, including 幸い–幸福; 進歩–発展/発達; 連続–次々; 遂に–とうとう/末; 前進–進む; 通過–通る/過ぎる; 通り過ぎる–通過; plus the other justified pairs recorded in exclusionsAddedBeyondEn. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so reverse declarations on baseline cards were withdrawn. 運 is titled «судьба; удача» so that it no longer duplicates 幸運. 遂に and とうとう share «наконец; в итоге» and are directly excluded.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 15 relative links across the 9 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 27 selected 30 N3 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 1 of 92 of the general remaining-word queue (closure of 2,757 EN words, recomputed after Batch187); chunk 0 remains queued. The set is closed under the source quiz-exclusion edges; 幸い→幸運 and 幸運→運 are the dependency edges inside the batch.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped: 道徳→礼儀; 過去→以前 and 未来; 過ごす→暮らす and 経つ; 幸い→不幸; 遅刻→欠席; 改善→kanji 改; 進学→就職; 進める→勧める; 友 and 連れ→仲間; 合格→優勝 and 成功. Five written kanji have no RU kanji card: 善, 徳, 改, 逮, 遂.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional additions: reverse declarations on baseline cards (Android checks either side); 運–幸せ and 幸運–幸せ (fate or luck versus happiness); 違いない–確か (the に違いない construction versus a reliability adjective or memory hedge); 遅刻–遅れる (a lateness noun versus the broader delay verb); 連想 against 関連/関係/連絡 (only the generic «связь» overlaps); 連続–連休 (a specific holiday term); 伸びる edges to 改善/進歩/上達 (a secondary improvement sense); the weaker overlaps 過去–昔, 通信–伝える/放送, 合格–試験 and other cross-part-of-speech pairs; return links where EN has only a plain-text mention. These were not established as direct answer ambiguities. No reviewer finding remains open.
